**The problem, from your own work**
What you were actually trying to do when this came up. Concrete beats general.

**Why the current behaviour doesn't cover it**

**What it should not become**
The clearest requests name their own limit. This tool deliberately isn't a text
editor, isn't a cloud service, and doesn't compete on orchestration breadth
(see *What this is not* territory in the README). Saying where your idea stops
makes it much easier to say yes to.
